ALL 4 review-request items PASS on the public preview URL (https://manifest-dreams-12.preview.emergentagent.com). rca_of_issue: REVIEWED BUG (fixed by E1, verified): red-screen 'undefined is not a function' at SubscriptionContext.tsx:115 (connectIAP undefined at runtime). Root cause confirmed as reported: deleted platform shims (iapService.native.ts / iapService.web.ts) contained only `export * from './iapService'` which Metro resolved back to the platform-suffixed file itself (self require-cycle), leaving all exports undefined. Verification: fresh boot + full 25-screen onboarding + OTP auth + demo trial + Home + Settings all pass with zero require-cycle warnings, zero page errors, and zero 'undefined is not a function' occurrences (monitored console + pageerror across the entire session).
